title: The Locker of Westbrook High
author: Ulyana Okafor
blurb: Petra Eastwick, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
